anomalies.impact: Tying the isolated sides together through ground defeats the transceivers’ galvanic isolation, allowing CAN-side ground faults or transients to couple into the logic ground.

parsed.summary: The CAN transceivers’ GND1 and GND2 sides appear tied to the same GND net, contrary to the specified isolated CAN interfaces. This would defeat galvanic isolation on both buses.
